claims.statement: The original sketch visibly relates Alles, Einbildung and Wahrheit and presents the heuristic 'Stimmt alles drei; 3 ist gut'.
The professional poster visually interprets the triad as reality, internal image and spoken truth claim, and relates information to past, present and future.
Reality to selective perception to internal model to linguistic statement is a useful epistemic process model.
Coherence of internal model and statement, including social consensus, is not by itself a truth guarantee.
Past artifacts can carry information into present reception and thereby influence future action through an ordinary forward-directed chain.
The figures do not establish physical retrocausality or mutation of past events.
Timeless, carrier-independent existence of information is not established by observed artifact persistence.
'3 ist gut' is retained as an explanatory heuristic, not as a theorem or sufficient truth criterion.
The epistemic triad introduces no wire field, protocol state, transition, priority rule or interoperability requirement.
Zenodo publication remains blocked until repository persistence, exact candidate return, candidate-specific owner authorization and public byte verification.
